method.conditions: Same pure plane, fixed initial state, no push/delay/physical randomization; paired cases differ only in controller. Command visualization disabled in all cases.
method.sampling: Diagnostic velocity/latent/action values are pre-action; position/angular-velocity fields are post-step, as in the existing evaluator. Bias compares only simultaneous pre-action velocity signals.
method.units: Teacher label and student prediction divided by configured observation scale 2.0 to obtain m/s.
method.windows: Half-open seconds. Standing excludes first 40 s; motion excludes first 1 s of each 6 s segment.
method.plot_smoothing: Only standing velocity panels use a 50-sample trailing mean (1 s). All reported statistics use raw values.
method.shadow_outputs: Unexecuted branch outputs are evaluated on the executed branch trajectory; they are not counterfactual closed-loop trajectories.

limitations: One seed and one environment per case.
Teacher uses simulator privileged information and is not a deployment policy.
Velocity and latent differences have not been independently ablated; velocity bias is not established as the sole cause.
Teacher also has motion/yaw tracking defects in this nominal-plane test.
